decisions.statement: A sweep takes no path on the command line.
The reach is read from the pages rather than said here.
A dry run reports what the run would take and takes nothing.
The report names each path taken.
A run finding nothing to take says so.
A path that would not go makes the call refuse.
A refusal names each path taken as well as each path that would not go.
A path that would not go is a fault in the world rather than in the call.
A checkout git names no directory for is a fault in the world too.
No name akasha keeps is taken.

definition: the command taking away what akasha left under the folder git does not track
